NSE.model: pure He4/Ni56 Maxwell-Boltzmann ideal nuclei, no other NSE species or screening

TOV_power.method: enthalpy and enclosed mass, DOP853; first h=0 surface; rising central-density branch only, not full radial-mode analysis

TOV_hybrid.method: enthalpy and enclosed mass, DOP853; first h=0 surface; rising central-density branch only, not full radial-mode analysis

EOS.chosen_anchors: average non-SQM Figure1, (n=.1,P=1) and (n=.5,P=100), P in MeV fm^-3
EOS.warning: given hybrid linear transition is acausal, even though high branch P=rho c^2 saturates the causal limit; power law also fails at high rho
